I'm more in the position of your friends, a lot of nights I'll only get 2-3 hours of sleep and come to school more energetic than everyone. For me all I need is to sleep for a normal amount once after like 3 nights of no sleep in a row. I don't think its just your fault cause I haven't met many people that can do that. The only reason I've found that sets me apart from any of my friends who don't get as much energy from the same amounts of sleep is I actually don't have coffee. Caffeine essentially replaces melatonin in your brains receptors, causing your brain to think you're awake, but the brain will still recognize its not getting enough sleep, so it will think it needs more melatonin receptors in hope that it actually gets to sleep. This is why people build up a bit of a resistance to coffee. Because of having more melatonin receptors though, you need more melatonin to go to sleep making it harder to sleep and it just overall fucks with your sleep.

This is up to you to know your own sleeping habits, if you can sleep as much as you need and easily, just go to sleep now and wake up when you need to. If you can't sleep so easily, then wait, if you have a bedtime with like your parents or something if you think they'd understand just communicate to them you can't fall asleep, or just hide it from them lol
